The FloPlast 112.5° square offset bend, crafted from high-quality black PVCu, provides an essential component for efficient rainwater downpipe systems. This 65mm square offset bend features a simple push-fit connection and a clean rectilinear profile. It is ideal for navigating architectural features on both new build installations and refurbishment projects, ensuring effective water diversion around exterior walls. Compatibility with most major manufacturers' systems makes this a versatile choice for professional plumbers and builders, providing durable exterior drainage for properties without the need for lubrication.
